data.title: S. Khonkaen Strengthens Entrée Brand with “Meet & Chips” Campaign Featuring Tle–FirstOne
data.description: S. Khonkaen Foods Public Company Limited (SORKON) continues to advance the marketing strategy of its Entrée brand through the “Entrée Meet & Chips: เติมโปรตีน ฟินคู่ชิปส์ with Tle & Firstone” campaign. The exclusive event offered selected campaign winners an opportunity to meet the brand’s two presenters up close, participate in special activities, and receive exclusive prizes in a fun-filled atmosphere that received an overwhelmingly warm response. The event further reinforced Entrée’s positioning as a high-protein snack brand that fits seamlessly into the lifestyles of today’s younger consumers.

data.title: TFM Posts Strong Q2 Growth, Declares THB 0.18 Interim Dividend
data.description: BANGKOK – 31 July 2026 – Thai Union Feedmill Public Company Limited, or TFM, reported strong operating results for the second quarter of 2026, with revenue increasing by 9.8% and net profit rising by 9.0% from the previous quarter. This performance brought the Company’s first-half sales revenue to THB 2.78 billion and net profit to THB 308 million, driven primarily by its shrimp feed business. TFM also announced an interim dividend payment of THB 0.18 per share, scheduled for 26 August 2026.

data.title: Piece of SpaceX rocket believed to have crashed into moon
data.description: WASHINGTON - A SpaceX rocket piece floating in space since last year was expected to have smashed into the moon at high speed early Wednesday morning, though the impact was unlikely to be confirmed for at least several hours.

data.title: Two suspects in Tak Bai police killings shot dead
data.description: NARATHIWAT - Two suspects linked to the fatal shooting of two Tak Bai police officers were killed in a gunfight with security forces in this southern province on Wednesday, while authorities later apprehended another suspect believed to have helped the duo evade arrest earlier.

data.title: Malaysia says Myanmar refugee return will not go ahead if lives are at risk
data.description: KUALA LUMPUR — Malaysia will ⁠not proceed with repatriating 5,000 ​Myanmar refugees if their lives are found to be at risk upon ​their return, a government spokesman said ‌on Wednesday, as authorities continued to screen the refugees ahead of the planned handover. Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim has said that the 5,000 to be repatriated were ethnic Rohingya refugees, and that the move ​was being carried out ⁠following rising tensions with local communities in Malaysia.

data.title: South Korea revives rail project that could link to North
data.description: SEOUL - South Korea will restart work on a railway section that could eventually link to the city of Wonsan in North Korea, the Unification Ministry said on Wednesday, reviving a project halted for a decade despite ​frozen relations with Pyongyang.

data.title: India monsoon floods, landslides kill more than 100 since July
data.description: NEW DELHI — Floods and landslides triggered by monsoon rains have killed more than 100 people across India since July, official data showed Wednesday, with thousands forced to flee their inundated homes.

data.title: The price of survival
data.description: The new Apple TV limited drama series Lucky is a high-stakes thriller about survival, identity and the difficult process of escaping the life you were born into. At the centre of the story is Luciana "Lucky" Armstrong (Anya Taylor-Joy), a brilliant but troubled con artist raised by her father, John Armstrong (Timothy Olyphant), a charming career criminal who taught her everything he knew about deception and survival -- except how to escape the world he created for her.

data.title: Myanmar civil war nears rare opening for talks
data.description: After more than five years of fighting, ​a rare window for talks over Myanmar’s devastating civil war is appearing, driven ‌by a shift on the battlefield where the military has regained ground and mounting regional pressure to engage.

data.title: South Korea pro baseball league cancels games over heatwave
data.description: SEOUL - South Korea's professional baseball league cancelled all games scheduled for Wednesday and Thursday amid a record-setting heatwave that has sent spectators to hospital.

data.title: PAÑPURI Introduces Care Eau de Parfum REDEFINED.
data.description: PAÑPURI, the acclaimed Thai niche fragrance and holistic wellness brand, introduces Care Eau de Parfum , a new alcohol-free collection for skin and hair that offers a more intimate expression of fine fragrance. Designed to deliver lasting scent in a lighter, more breathable form, the collection brings together fragrance, daily ritual, and care for the body in one gesture.
